prompt:
Image 1 is the hero of this game: a Q-style super-deformed chibi mage, about two and a half heads tall with an enormous head, huge round sparkling eyes and an oversized floppy hood, in a blue and white robe with gold trim, holding a tall staff with a glowing cyan crystal. Use this exact character design.

TASK: Draw a wide, bright, celebratory SPLASH SCREEN / title key art for this game.

COMPOSITION: the chibi mage stands front and centre, drawn LARGE, in a heroic casting pose: staff raised high overhead with the cyan crystal blazing, the other little fist clenched, feet planted wide apart, a huge determined grin on the face. Around and behind the mage, a few much SMALLER cartoon enemies react to the spell - a round violet flame spirit recoiling on one side and a little crimson hooded wraith with glowing eyes on the other side, with a few smaller ones further back. Big cartoon spell effects: a bright cyan and gold magic circle on the ground under the mage, radiating energy rings, and a shower of sparkles and star glints filling the air.

IMPORTANT - LEAVE ROOM FOR A TITLE: keep the TOP THIRD of the image relatively open and uncluttered, filled with sky and sparkles rather than characters or busy detail, so a game logo can be placed there later. Keep the mage's head below that top area.

BACKGROUND: a bright, cheerful cartoon sky over a colourful stone arena, with soft clouds, a warm glow and floating magical motes. Upbeat and inviting.

ART DIRECTION: Q-style chibi anime. VERY THICK bold dark ink outlines on every character, flat 2-tone cel shading, saturated cheerful colours - royal blue, gold, cyan, warm orange - high key and vibrant. One key light from the upper-left. Clean and readable, like the cover of a colourful children's game.

TECHNICAL OUTPUT: 3:2 landscape, edge-to-edge artwork, opaque, no transparency.

EXCLUDE: any text, letters, words, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, UI elements, buttons, borders, frames, a dark or moody palette, realistic proportions, tall characters, gore.
